text:
Sara H: rolling request — need a new gpu nodepool in eu-north1 for low-latency inference tests. target workload: 2k qps light tokens, bursty.
Tony L: ok, what's the planned instance mix? A100 only or multi-sku?
Sara H: multi-sku. primary A100s for prod-like perf, fallback to A10G, then to T4 for capacity. quotas in that region are tight so fallback necessary.
Ingrid M: are we doing preemptible/spot for the fallback tiers? helps cost but increases churn.
Sara H: yes. plan: A100 reserved (dedicated), A10G mixed preemptible+on-demand, T4 strictly spot for burst. keep min nodes small so autoscaler can spin up when needed.
Kevin P: what about taints/labels and CA behavior? We need to avoid scheduling critical control-plane tests onto spot T4s.
Tony L: suggest kube taint: gpu-tier=A100:NoSchedule on A100 pool; gpu-tier=A10G:PreferNoSchedule on A10; gpu-tier=T4:NoSchedule plus nodeAffinity for a "burst" toleration.
Ingrid M: PreferNoSchedule isn't a real taint effect — you mean taint with NoSchedule plus a toleration on lower-priority pods?
Tony L: yeah my bad, meant NoSchedule with pod tolerations for workloads we want to admit to A10G. for burst-only pods we give toleration to T4.
Sara H: autoscaler config: cluster-autoscaler with multiple nodegroups. min/max for pools: A100 min 2 max 10, A10G min 0 max 30, T4 min 0 max 60. CA expander: priority or least-waste?
Kevin P: use priority for predictable scaling: prefer A100, then A10G, then T4. also enable scale-down delay for spot tiers (e.g., scaleDownDelayAfterAdd: 20m) to avoid thrash.
Ingrid M: quota check — current GPU quota in eu-north1: 10 A100, 40 A10, 0 T4 (we haven't requested). Who owns quota requests?
Tony L: finance/benchmarks asked us to push more on T4 and A10 since A100 is expensive. I'll open a ticket to cloud quota with projected numbers. we need vCPU and gpus both.
Sara H: networking: new pool will need NAT egress capacity. Past issues where burst pools exhausted ephemeral IPs and pods stuck Pending. need to reserve new NAT/egress IPs for eu-north1.
Kevin P: +1. Also add podAnnotations for external-networking egress policy so we can pin high-priority pods to reserved IPs.
Ingrid M: suggestion: use node local NAT gateway per-az and annotate nodepool subnets. avoids single NAT GW running out.
Tony L: downside: more NATs, more routes. Ops cost but safer.
Sara H: rolling plan: create nodepools via terraform module gpu-nodepool, with tags, taints, and autoscaler config. snippet: 
```
module "eu-north-a100" {
  source = "git::ssh://git@repo/infra-modules.git//gpu-nodepool"
  name = "np-eun-a100"
  machine_type = "n1-ultramem-a100"
  min_size = 2
  max_size = 10
  taints = ["gpu-tier=A100:NoSchedule"]
  labels = { tier = "gpu", class = "a100" }
}
```
Kevin P: makes sense. ensure nodeAffinity rules included for cloud provider to prefer certain AZs (avoid high egress contention).
Ingrid M: also add PodDisruptionBudget for critical pods and set maxUnavailable conservatively. last time CA nuked a bunch of tests during scale-down.
sre-bot: incident-note: historical eu-north1 burst pool egress exhaustion on 2025-11-03 caused 8% job failure rate. link: https://redwood.incidents/INC-20251103
Tony L: good catch bot. let's schedule a preflight: quota ticket, terraform plan, NAT capacity check, and one canary deployment with synthetic traffic.
Sara H: can someone do the quota request and NAT sizing? I'll own the terraform changes and canary.
Kevin P: I'll take NAT sizing and preflight networking (subnet CIDR, reserved IPs).
Ingrid M: I'll open the quota ticket and include expected GPU hours and vCPU. Will CC finance for cost approval.
Tony L: timeline?
Sara H: aim to merge infra changes by EOD Thursday, quota requests submitted today, canary next Monday.
Kevin P: sounds good. :thumbsup:
Ingrid M: ping me once quota is approved, I'll update the autoscaler caps accordingly.
Sara H: thanks all — I'll drop the terraform PR link here when ready.
Tony L: reminder: document the fallback prioritization in the rollout playbook so SREs can manually trigger fallback if CA behaves weirdly.
Sara H: will do.
Kevin P: LGTM
